summary: Repair the required Clippy and mixed-version rollback checks without changing runtime behavior.

compatibility.detail: The wake rollback test includes closed wake history and applies graph precedence for duplicate subjects, while checking physical stream retention. The conversation rollback test asserts the documented 410 cursor-gap when a newer cursor has more fields than the release supports, checks a full resync retains all supported history, and preserves resume checks for supported cursor shapes.
